messages:
Tara (PM): Quick thread - we need to finalize the deprecation incentives and migration policy wording. Sales is pushing to shorten pin windows for faster upgrades but Legal needs clear opt-in language. Trying to capture compromises here.

Rosa (Sales): Customers want predictable timelines. If we offer a migration credit (e.g., 30% credits for migration ops) they might accept a shorter pin (45 days) if assisted migration is included. Can we formalize a credits + assisted migration option?

Kai (Legal): We can do credits but need explicit consent opt-in and a liability clause. Migration assistance must be documented: scope, SLAs, and data handling (no retention beyond cutover unless customer signs). Also require customers to acknowledge a deprecation notice at least 21 days before action.

Owen (Eng): From infra: we can support a 45d pin with assisted migration, but only if the model entry includes a compat_tag and an automated migration shim (if schema diffs are shallow). Otherwise it's manual; estimate 2-4 engineer-days per large migration. Need escalation matrix.

Priya (ML): For embeddings: we must detect vector-schema changes. Suggest we add a catalog flag: "schema_compatible_with_prev=true/false". If false, assisted migration requires an adapter and test harness. Also require an eval drift report (cosine drift) pre/post migration.

Mikkel (SRE): Operational constraints: we need a guaranteed rollback SLA during cutover: 4-hour rollback window where we can revert traffic to previous variant automatically. Also mandate a canary with traffic ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50% over 24-48h) and an error-budget threshold that triggers immediate rollback.

Tara (PM): Draft policy idea: default pin = 90d. Option A (assisted migration + credits) -> pin = 45d, must include: compat_tag, migration test harness, signed opt-in, and budgeted migration support hours. Option B (no assistance) -> pin = 90d. We should publish both choices in the catalog entry.

Rosa (Sales): Is there a way to automate the opt-in in the console? Customers hate paperwork. Even a checkbox during model selection + email confirmation would be fine.

Kai (Legal): Checkbox + email confirmation is OK if we store consent record. Also need to include the deprecation notice language and a link to the migration-runbook. Legal will draft minimal clauses.

Owen (Eng): Tech requirements for assisted migration: 1) variant matrix with recommended kernels; 2) auto-transform adapter if embed dims change but type stays same; 3) test harness with sample queries and acceptance thresholds. We can autotest with the submitted eval set.

Priya (ML): ACs for acceptance: (1) Bench payload uploaded (samples, p95, p99, avg_tokens, failure_rate); (2) compat_tag present; (3) eval suite + checksum; (4) migration adapter or manual-hours estimate; (5) rollout plan with rollback SLA. Example bench JSON: ```{"samples":1000,"p95_ms":200,"p99_ms":430,"avg_tokens":18,"failure_rate":0.001,"embed_drift":0.012}```

Mikkel (SRE): Add alerts: token-cost delta >25% sustained 1h, p95 up >30% sustained 30m, and a canary-error-rate spike rule (x3 baseline in 2h). During assisted migration we enable extended telemetry retention for 60d.

Tara (PM): OK owners: Owen -> migration adapter spec + console opt-in flow; Priya -> eval/checksum template + drift thresholds; Mikkel -> rollback SLA + alert rules; Kai -> opt-in/legal copy; Rosa -> commercial credit playbook. I'll open ticket #9201 and draft the public catalog blurb.

catalog-bot: Created ticket #9201 "deprecation-incentive-and-migration-policy" https://redwood/tickets/9201

Rosa (Sales): One more ask - consider a small "early-adopter" bonus (extra credits) if customer migrates within first 30 days of deprecation notice. Sales thinks that will reduce long tails.

Kai (Legal): Early-adopter bonus OK as marketing/credit; must be separate from SLAs and include an expiration. We'll draft wording.

Priya (ML): Suggest we auto-flag catalog entries with a numeric "migration_complexity" score based on embed-dim change, tokenizer diff, and parameter count. That helps estimate manual hours and credit amount.

Owen (Eng): Good idea. We can compute a coarse score at ingest time. If complexity > threshold require manual onboarding and a named SRE/Eng lead.

Tara (PM): Great. I'll add that to #9201 and schedule a 30m spec review Thursday 11:00. If no objections today we'll push the PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
